text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I won!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...My edge has dulled. I must re-hone
myself.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Does this mean you'll be participating in
races
seriously next year?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to do the same. I'll be
happy to do so
just to get another
chance to race with you.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Spare me the flattery. There are plenty
of racers
who can entertain you besides
me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You mean the juniors? You're not wrong.
There is
beauty in these up-and-comers.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш—you're good, but you won't
escape
me next time.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
No matter my opponent, what I must do
remains
unchanged.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will continue to get consistent results,
even
during my senior year. And then...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will become someone I can be proud
of...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. I admit that was a fierce
battle.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But at the moment, I would prefer words
of praise
rather than concern.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. The strength of my
competitors far
exceeded my
expectations... but I still managed
to do
well.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
After such a ferocious battle, I am ever
more
confident that I am on the correct
path...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Per my original plan, I wish to run G1
races during
my senior year as well.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Which means my first hurdle will be the
Senior
Spring Triple Crown's opening
race, the Osaka
Hai.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Trainer... It just occurred to me, but...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Alles in Ordnung—it means "all is well."
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I had anticipated for the senior racers to
be
strong, but even so, I have been able
to progress
along my path.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
What's more, I even achieved victory.
The races
next year should not be as
much of a struggle as
today's so long as I
continue to improve.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I wonder... Is it too soon to believe I can

complete the rest of my schedule?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Bzzzt... Bzzzzt...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Go ahead and take that call.

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ja, hallo.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш starts talking to who I
assume are her
parents when suddenly...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wirklich?!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
My mother and father are planning to
come to
Japan to watch me race!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: It is! I'm so happy!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But this is truly a shock. My parents are
both
extremely busy and systematic
people.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Even their visit to see my tryouts was
made only
after I decided to study
abroad.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
In fact, I believe they must have made
this
decision long ago...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: They must really want to see you race.

text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. My parents said so themselves.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
They've apparently made time to come
during the
latter half of October next
year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I run through Эйсин Флэш's schedule in
my head
and line up the dates.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: They'll be here for the autumn Tenno Sho, then!

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll have to train accordingly to be
in peak
condition for then.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I must keep my promise...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I just promised to show my parents how
much I
have grown.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I said I will run the perfect race before
them and
that I'll win every race along
the way until that
point.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I told them that I will not know defeat in
my
senior year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Perhaps I promised them too much...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
Winning everything has been my plan from the
beginning.

text_block_list.text: Right!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I will send my parents the race details.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
A thought occurs to me as I see Eishin
Flash off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Quite a few Umamusume who made a
name for
themselves in their generation
have become
active in races again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The question is, why? I don't have an
answer, but
I can't help but feel
unsettled as things lead up to
the Osaka
Hai...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
